Daikin Zone Control  Compatible with all Daikin, Goodman and Amana Unitary R32 inverter driven communicating HVAC systems.  Control up to 6 air zones with 24Vac Power Open/Close zone dampers with a 35s travel time.  Each zone can handle up to 6VA worth of zone dampers.  Modulating damper control.  Static Pressure management with required differential pressure sensor.  No bypass needed.  Zone auto-weight function with required pressure sensor.  Zone board commissioning through the thermostat UI or with Quality Install through SkyportCare. 5 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Zone Control Features Auxiliary Contacts Provided  The Daikin Zone Control Panel has two dry contact relays for engaging AC or DC controlled auxiliary devices. Auxiliary devices must be set up in the smart thermostat setup menu.  Whole house humidifier.  Whole house dehumidifier.  AUX heating source. 6 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Pressure Sensor  Pressure sensor comes with default settings:  Minimum 0.5” wc.  Maximum 0.7” wc.  Has 2 pressure release algorithms.  1. Normal release algorithm. Thermostat will read indoor blower CFM and compare to the max zone CFM. If blower CFM is too high, thermostat will open another zone to bleed. It is less aggressive. Only opens required dampers to maintain high static.  2. Aggressive release algorithm- zone pressure sensor reads higher than 0.7, opens all dampers to 100%. 7 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Zone Control Features Removeable Connectors  Removable connectors make it easy for installation and future serviceability.  All the connectors are labelled for easy identification. 8 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Daikin Zone Control  Zone board will check all zones during power up. If a zone damper is detected, the zone board will turn ON the corresponding green status LED on the front panel.  Zone board automatically checks all zones every 5 minutes.  Damper Test Button.  Press once: Opens all dampers, then closes them one by one. “Test” LED blinks green during test.  Press 5 secs: Keeps all dampers open. “Test” LED stays Solid green. Press 5 secs again to exit test 9 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Compatible with:  You can use the wireless RHT sensors as a zone device.  You can connect up to 8 RHT sensors to 1 Daikin One+ Thermostat. Zone 1 Zone 2 Zone 3 Zone 4-RHT Sensors Averaged Zone 5-RHT Sensor Averaged w/ Daikin One+ 11 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Compatible Dampers  Daikin Zone Control Panel was designed to work with any 24VAC PO/PC damper actuator with a 35s travel time.  Each zone can hold up to 6VA worth of damper motors. Calculate your total damper output based on your zone and duct layout. 12 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Mounting Control Board  Choose a suitable location to mount the Daikin Zone Control housing.  Preferred locations would be a return duct, nearby wall, or convenient studs where plywood can be installed to support the housing.  AVOID: Supply duct, air handler, furnace housing, evaporator housing, or hot water coils of any type.  Follow national and/or local electrical codes. Used for stud mounting Used for panel mounting 14 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.
Installing the Control Panel Routing Wires Remove individual break-away dust tabs from exit ports by hand or use pliers as needed 15 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Installing the Control Panel Connecting Wires to Control Panel  Remove terminal blocks as needed to connect leads from thermostats and zone dampers.  Zip-tie or route leads through tie-down platforms  Route leads out to equipment through provided exit ports  Reinsert terminal blocks. 16 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Wiring Dampers to Board Terminal Block Designation & Function  Standard 24vac damper control.  Terminal PC - 24vac power to close the damper.  Terminal PO - 24vac power to open a damper.  Terminal C - 24vac common. (neutral) 17 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Wiring Multiple Dampers Into One Damper Terminal  You can connect up to four dampers to a single zone.  Three sets of damper wires can terminate (piggyback) into one damper terminal. (two shown here) You CANNOT connect any RSD or competitor’s spring type damper to the Daikin Zoning Panel 18 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Installing the Control Panel Connecting Aux and Data Wires to Control Panel  Remove power terminal block, data terminal block and A2L Alarm terminal block.  Zip-tie or route leads through tie-down platforms  Route leads out to equipment through provided exit ports 19 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Installation Good Wiring Practice  Avoid using different gauge (AWG) wires.  Never terminate three or more wires inside a C OK single terminal.  If two wires are terminated inside a single 2 Bad terminal, twist the exposed copper together prior to inserting the wires into the terminal. 1 Good  When using wire caps, insert the wires into the R Best cap and utilize the cap to twist the wires. Avoid twisting the wires prior, this will diminish the connection.  Always make a one-to-one connection when possible! Bad  Maintain a bias voltage of 0.6-0.9vdc. Good 27 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Commissioning Control Panel Thermostat Firmware Upgrade  In smart thermostat setup screen, choose “communication” menu, setup the Wi-Fi connection. Thermostats will automatically update to latest firmware. After update, thermostat will automatically reboot.  Note: You will need to update firmware on every thermostat connected to the zone panel before commissioning.  Note: If more than 3 thermostats update at the same time, it may take longer for update to complete. Please do not proceed before all updates are completed.  All commissioning steps will be performed through the primary thermostat except for naming additional thermostats, connecting RHT sensors, and connecting the thermostat to the Wi-Fi. Commissioning can be performed on the thermostat or VIA SkyportCare. 30 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Commissioning Control Panel Setup Thermostat Name  In each smart thermostat setup screen, choose “personalization”. Update each thermostats name. Assign a different name to each zone thermostat. This will help you in future screens when you assign each device to its specific zone.  If you do not name each thermostat, every thermostat that is not named will read “main room”. This will lead to confusion when you go to assign each device to its designated zone. 31 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Commissioning Control Panel Setup Thermostat Role  In smart thermostat setup screen, choose “equipment setup”. Choose “zone board”. Choose “thermostat role”.  At first power up, all thermostats' roles will be set to “additional” automatically. If no primary is selected, thermostat will report an E36 error and give an alert. The IDU will report an E77 error code (not finding thermostat).  Set Zone 1 as primary thermostat. After a primary thermostat is selected, indoor E77 will go away.  If multiple thermostats are selected as primary, thermostat will pop up an alert. No primary thermostat Multiple primary thermostats 32 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Commissioning Control Panel Start Zoning Wizard  After assigning the thermostat role, you will start the zoning wizard in the zone board menu. The zoning wizard will take you through each step of the commissioning process for the Daikin Zone Panel. 33 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Commissioning Control Panel Setup Wired Sensor  Pressure sensor is unchecked by default. Enable the pressure sensor by checking “diff pressure sensor”.  Enable high airflow relief feature.  When enabled, if the zone board detects static pressure higher than “max pressure”, it will activate high airflow relief and open all dampers 100% for 5 minutes. After 5 minutes, zone board will check if static pressure is lower than “min pressure”, if lower, zone board will exit high airflow relief and resume to normal operation. If not, zone board will stay in high airflow relief for another 5 minutes.  After set up is configured, press continue. DEFAULT RECOMMENDED for Furnace + Coil Recommended for Air Handler Max Pressure 0.7 0.7 0.7 Min Pressure 0.5 0.5 0.5 34 Note: if pressure transducer measures include media filter, please add media filter pressure drop to “Max pressure”, and “Min pressure”. Media filter pressure drop value could be found in the media filter specification. © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Commissioning Control Panel Setup “Enable Zones”  In the “enable zones” screen, zone 1 is “always on”. If any zone shows “detected”, it means the zone board detects a damper. From here you can enable detected zones by selecting the boxes next to each zone.  If you do not see a zone damper, go to the panel and damper motors and check all wiring connections.  When satisfied with the zones that are enabled, press continue. You will get a pop up that will allow you to run auto-weight (recommended).  Auto-weight will run in the background as the commissioning process is completed. 35 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Commissioning Control Panel Setup “Assign Zone Devices”  “Assign zone devices” will show all connected thermostats and wireless zone sensors. Thermostat name will be the name assigned in the “personalization” step.  Default name is “mainroom”.  If thermostat is missing, check wiring.  If needed to add a wireless RHT sensor, follow the instructions that are in the RHT sensor box.  “Unassigned” text will display if the device has not been assigned to a zone.  In “assign zone devices” screen, click on the devices, it will display all the zones that are in the “enable zones” step. Click to assign to the correct zone.  After all devices have been assigned press continue. 36 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Commissioning Control Panel Setup “Zone Setting”  In the zone board screen, choose “zone setting”. It shows all zone thermostats and zone RHT sensors.  Click the device to enter setup screen. In setup screen, zone name, enable voting, setpoint limits and overcool/deadband options show up.  Enable voting:  if checked, this zone can independently call for cool/heat.  If unchecked, this zone cannot independently call for cool/heat. It will only heat/cool while there is another zone calling. 37 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Commissioning Control Panel Setup “Zone Setting” cont’  Setpoint limits and overcool deadband can be addressed here for each individual zone.  Setpoint limits allows you to set min/max set points for individual zones.  Deadband allows you to set the gap between heating and cooling when using auto mode.  Overcooling to dehumidify will allow you to set how far you want to overshoot setpoint in an attempt to reach your dehumidification setpoint. 38 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Commissioning Control Panel Setup “Zone Weight”  When you get to the zone weight menu and “auto weight” has not completed, you will see a message that shows how much time you have remaining for autoweight to complete.  When “auto weight” completes, zone weight will show the weight for each zone. You can then manually adjust the zone weight. 39 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Commissioning Control Panel Zone Test  In zone test, choose “run test”.  Installer can use this test to verify damper operation and airflow for each zone.  When a zone is checked, it will open all dampers for that zone and run the CFM assigned to it in “zone weight” for that zone.  If a zone is unchecked, it will close that zone.  Zone test does not time out, it is a manual start/stop.  While zone test is running, installer can go back to “zone weight” screen to fine tune the weight to achieve best performance.  After zone weight adjustment, please allow up to 1 minute for damper to adjust. 40 Select “complete zone board installation” to finish © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Commissioning Control Panel Completing Zoning Commissioning  After completion of the zoning commissioning, continue with the system commissioning process.  Refer to product Installation Manual. 41 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Commissioning Control Panel Aux Output Port Setting  The zone board provides two dry contact aux outputs  From equipment setup > add equipment, in the smart thermostat setup menu, two dry contact aux outputs can be configured to control  Aux heat source  Humidifier  Dehumidifier  In connection menu, installer assigns device to corresponding aux terminal.  Devices can be assigned to thermostat aux terminals or Zone Board aux terminals.  Installer can adjust the desired settings for that device. 42 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

SkyportCare - Quality Install  Verify thermostat is connected to Wi-Fi and updated with the current firmware version.  Verify the primary zone has been selected on thermostat  Download the SkyportCare app. from your respective app. store.  You need to create an account to log in  User ID and password (case sensitive)  In SkyportCare app, select the tools screen. Then select the thermostats icon to enter job list screen. 47 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Commissioning With SkyportCare App Creating Job  Within the tools section, select the model of the primary thermostat being installed.  From the thermostat screen select quality install.  In the job list, add a job by hitting the + in the top right corner. 48 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Commissioning With SkyportCare App Add a Job  When you add a job, you will need to add a location for that job.  You can manually enter the address for that job or use the GPS location within your phone.  If you use your GPS location always double check that the address is correct, before moving on.  This job will be uploaded to your organizations SkyportCare account.  This will allow your organization to view and adjust the customers system in the future, with their permission. 49 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Commissioning With SkyportCare App Adding Thermostat  In job tasks screen, add all thermostats and 1 wireless RHT sensors into the tasks list. 1. In the app, click “Add thermostat to job”. 2. Go to thermostat, in thermostat setup screen, click “thermostat ID”, QR code will pop up. 3. Scan this QR code, thermostat DKN number will automatically be populated in the box.  For adding wireless RHT sensor, follow sensor instruction. 2 3 50 © 2026 Daikin Comfort Technologies North America, Inc.

Commissioning With SkyportCare App Adding Thermostat Cont’d 4. Skyportcare app and primary thermostat will prompt. App will request remote access permission, and thermostat will ask to allow permission.  Granting permission will allow remote access for 3.5 hrs. 5. Pressure sensor is unchecked by default. Turn on “diff pressure sensor” and "High airflow relief".  Set min/max pressure if needed.  High airflow relief feature  If enabled, when the zone board detects static pressure higher than “max pressure”, it will activate high airflow relief and open all dampers 100% for 5 minutes. After 5 minutes, zone board will check if static pressure is lower than “min pressure”, if lower, zone board will exit high airflow relief and resume to normal operation. If not, zone board will stay in high airflow relief for another 5 minutes. Commissioning With SkyportCare App Setup “Zone Weight”  If you get to the zone weight menu prior to auto-weight completion, you will see a message that shows the remaining time for autoweight to complete.  After auto-weight completes, it will show zone weight for each zone.  You can then go in and manually adjust the zone weight if needed.
